Read the repository-root AGENTS.md first, including its Codespaces continuation
section, then docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md and the source/Git state. AGENTS.md is
the product/agent contract; these instructions only route you to it. Read relevant
.commandcode/skills/*/SKILL.md from disk. Reply in Spanish.

Continue the existing mobile practice app on ai-1 unless the user selects another
branch. Do not scaffold a replacement, require Devin, connect live payment/Google
providers, or invent device/user-test results. If dependencies are absent in a
Codespace, run bash .devcontainer/setup.sh. Run npm run dev to work interactively.
No commit/push without specific user authorization for the current action.
